record_scope_reconstruction: Two distinct January2022 protest movements in CristoRedentor corridor: Argentine-side obstruction of inbound Chile-to-Argentina trucks, and Chile-bound exit from Uspallata integrated-control yard sinceJanuary17. Health-testing queues alone are not the deliberate blockade footprint.

Full January18 report locates outbound blockade at exit of integrated-control yard in Uspallata sinceMondayafternoon; describes holdingparks separately.
OfficialJanuary28 notice changes Chile entry-testing protocols; does not itself locate every protest point or establish actual blockade clearance.
